title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We are seeking a detail\-oriented Test Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality of our products by meeting specific testing metrics and quality objectives. Success in this position will be measured by reduction in production defects, testing efficiency, and ability to maintain high\-quality standards throughout the development lifecycle.**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------

* Achieve 95%\+ test coverage for all new features and major updates
* Reduce escaped defects (bugs found in production) by at least 20% within 6 months
* Maintain a defect closure rate of at least 90% for each sprint
* Complete 100% of assigned test cases within sprint timeframes
* Contribute to reducing overall QA cycle time by 15% through process improvements

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, develop, and execute 20\+ comprehensive test plans per quarter, ensuring 90%\+ test coverage
* Create and maintain at least 50 automated test scripts each quarter, with 98% reliability rate
* Identify and log 90% of critical defects before code reaches staging environments
* Reduce average defect resolution time from 72 hours to 48 hours through clear documentation
* Conduct 10\+ cross\-browser/device compatibility tests per release
* Complete performance testing for all new features, ensuring they meet defined performance benchmarks
* Decrease regression testing time by 20% through optimized test suites and automation
* Participate in 100% of sprint planning and review meetings, providing QA perspective
* Submit weekly metrics reports covering test execution status, defect trends, and quality risks
* Mentor 1\-2 junior QA team members per year

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience)
* 3\+ years of experience in software testing with demonstrable metrics of success
* Proven track record of reducing production defects by at least 15% year over year
* Experience managing 500\+ test cases within test management systems
* Demonstrated ability to automate at least 60% of regression test suites
* Proficiency in at least one testing framework with ability to create 30\+ reliable test scripts per month
* Experience with performance testing, consistently identifying 85% of performance bottlenecks before production
* History of maintaining 95%\+ accuracy in defect reporting and documentation

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript) with ability to write 200\+ lines of clean test code daily
* Experience with test management tools, managing 300\+ test cases simultaneously
* Demonstrated ability to create automated test frameworks that reduce manual testing by 40%
* Knowledge of SQL with ability to validate data integrity across 10\+ database tables
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, reducing build verification time by 25%

description:

Company Overview
  
  

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  

Job Overview
  
  

ROLE PURPOSE
  
  

Serve as the programme's Jira Cloud subject\-matter authority in support of Client's migration execution. The role advises on target\-state architecture, rationalization, app strategy, and validation approach — ensuring Client's migration engineering team executes against a clean, well\-designed cloud destination — without itself owning migration execution.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

**Advise on target\-state Atlassian Cloud architecture:** site and plan topology, sandbox strategy, data residency posture, identity and access patterns (SSO/SCIM, Atlassian Guard), and permission/governance models.
  
**Lead rationalization recommendations ahead of each wave:** workflows, custom fields, schemes, screens, dashboards, and Confluence space structures — reducing migration payload and post\-migration debt.
  
**Own the Marketplace app gap analysis:** Data Center app inventory, cloud equivalence assessment, Connect\-to\-Forge implications, and recommendations to replace, retire, or rebuild — a primary driver of wave complexity classification.
  
Advise on integration patterns for rebuilt or replaced integrations with enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow), in coordination with the Senior Cloud Engineer and Client integration owners.
  
Support wave criteria definition and per\-project complexity assessment; contribute to go/no\-go readiness reviews.
  
Define the validation and verification approach for migrated data and configuration (staging\-first migration, integrity comparison, user mapping consistency) and review verification outcomes with Client's migration engineers.
  
Provide escalation\-level troubleshooting guidance during migration windows and hypercare; document architectural decisions and standards in Confluence.
  
  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE
  
  

10\+ years of Atlassian platform expertise spanning Jira Data Center and Jira Cloud administration/architecture at enterprise scale (5,000\+ users).
  
Direct experience with Data Center\-to\-Cloud migration assessment and planning, including familiarity with Atlassian's cloud migration tooling and staged (staging\-to\-production) migration approaches.
  
Deep knowledge of the Atlassian Marketplace ecosystem, including cloud app parity analysis and the Connect/Forge platform transition.
  
Strong grasp of enterprise identity, security, and governance in Atlassian Cloud (Atlassian Guard/Access, SSO/SCIM, data residency).
  
Ability to communicate architectural trade\-offs crisply to both engineers and programme leadership.
  
  

PREFERRED
  
  

Atlassian certifications (e.g., ACP\-level Jira administration).
  
Experience in regulated industries where validation evidence and auditability matter.
  
Exposure to SAFe\-aligned Jira configuration at scale.
  
  

Compensation

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Kochi, India
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.



Over 50 million people use Speechify's text\-to\-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text\-to\-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.


Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.


**Overview**



The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.



This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast\-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.



We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.



Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

* Collaborate on B2B solutions, focusing on customization and integration needs for enterprise clients
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience


**An Ideal Candidate Should Have**


* Proven experience in backend development: TS/Node (required)
* Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
* Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
* Preferred: Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
* Preferred: Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes


**What We Offer**

* A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
* A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
* Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
* The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
* Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
* The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
* An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

title: Software Engineer (AI)
description:
Fresher
 **Software Engineer (AI)**
-----------------------------------


  
Job Description: We are looking for a curious and driven AI Research Developer to join our expanding team. In this role, you will explore prototype and benchmark emerging AI techniques while working with our engineering teams to turn promising research into deployable software. This position suits candidates who enjoy reading papers, reproducing results, and translating them into working code for real products across cloud and edge environments. Key Responsibilities: Track recent developments in generative AI, agentic systems, and model optimization, and assess their relevance to ongoing and upcoming projects. Reproduce results from research papers and open\-source repositories and build proof\-of\-concept prototypes. Design and run experiments: dataset preparation, training/fine\-tuning runs, ablation studies, and evaluation against defined metrics. Benchmark models for accuracy, latency, memory footprint, and throughput on target hardware. Work with product and engineering teams to hand over validated approaches, including documentation, reference implementations, and integration support. Write clear technical reports, internal documentation, and presentations for both technical and non\-technical audiences. May have to interact with customers to understand problem statements and propose feasible AI approaches. Participate in code reviews, experiment reviews, and team knowledge\-sharing sessions.
  

Skills and Qualifications Must Have: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electronics, Mathematics, or a relevant field. Strong programming skills in Python. Solid grounding in machine learning and deep learning fundamentals: activation functions (ReLU, GELU, SiLU, Softmax), loss functions, optimizers, regularization, and evaluation metrics. Good understanding of Transformer internals (Attention, MLP, LayerNorm, RoPE) and of CNN, RNN, LSTM, and Vision Transformer architectures. Hands\-on experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem. Understanding of the LLM inference pipeline, tokenization, sampling strategies, and KV caching. Familiarity with fine\-tuning techniques (LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, instruction tuning) and experiment tracking. Good knowledge of graph and vector databases and RAG implementation. Strong data structures, algorithms, problem\-solving, and analytical skills. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Ability to read research papers critically and communicate findings clearly. Good to Have: Exposure to quantization, pruning, and distillation techniques for model compression. Experience with inference runtimes such as llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, ONNX Runtime, or TensorRT. Familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, MCP\-based tooling) and multi\-step reasoning systems. Exposure to GPU/NPU programming concepts (CUDA, OpenCL) and profiling tools. Exposure to FastAPI / Django / SQLAlchemy for serving prototypes. Publications, preprints, open\-source contributions, or competition results in a relevant area. Working knowledge of C/C\+\+.
  

1\) Fill registration form.
2\) Attend the quiz online (approx. 30 mins)
3\) Schedule coding Test in Electrifex office at Kochi
4\) Technical interview 1 in Electrifex office at Kochi
5\) Technical interview 2 in Electrifex office at Kochi
6\) HR interview in Electrifex office at Kochi
